tips.text: Finish the mission after refusing a Candidate; an aborted run leaves her weapon in the pool and wastes the Crown.
Run Hydra on normal, not Steel Path; Sister results are identical and the Void enemies are far tougher.
Bring the Xoris; detonate it on the captive Solaris to extend the Granum Void timer.
Stand still in the Void; wandering strands the Specter kills you already earned.
Restart if the Golden Hand is within about 200 m of extraction; the Candidate will not spawn.
Stab her as soon as you have a reasonable guess; wrong guesses still award Murmurs.
Use Oull as a wildcard Requiem so you only need to reveal two mods.
Do not save Corrupted Holokeys for this weapon; Ergo Glast does not sell it.
Keep the first functional weapon and treat a 60% bonus as a separate long-term goal.
Expect one to three hours per Sister, mostly Granum Void reruns to land the right weapon.
Players say the missions are fine and chasing a 60% roll is the real grind.
